#Module workers

Dedicated workers (HTML). A message event carries the text in Event_data, the number of transferred buffers in Event_code and the first one in Event_object; the buffers belong to the receiver. Invalid_Argument for a handle that is not a transferable buffer or appears twice, a message over workers.max_message_bytes, a receiver with too much waiting, or a function of the other side (a page calling a worker function or the reverse).

Exposed to: Window, Worker. Source: api/workers.widl.

#Types

#handle Worker : Object

A Worker object (EventTarget: message, messageerror, error).

#handle WorkerGlobalScope : Object

The global scope of a worker (EventTarget: message, messageerror).
